english_text: The judgment is invalid because the regional court in Munich dismissed the action against Tobias Pflüger on 21 July 2009 in the second and final instance . It is politically unacceptable that this report , which contains incorrect facts , was voted in plenary today ( 24 November 2009 ) . This kind of proceeding by the European Parliament creates the impression of supporting the persecution of politically active persons , in this case , the Munich II Public Prosecution Service against the former Member of the European Parliament , Tobias Pflüger . We have tried to get this incomplete and therefore incorrect report taken off the agenda , unfortunately without success .
